source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Include the tester’s name, job title, date of the test with the time and at what location the tests took place.
3. List the manufacturers name and model of test equipment used.
4. Include date of last calibration and calibration due date for each test device.
5. At least one PASS label should exist for every asset that PASS/Acceptance was gained.
These should be attached using tamper proof material such as tamper proof fastener, threadlocker etc.
6. For all devices and equipment that are not re-tested for some time after the initial PAT testing the asset label should also reflect the due date of the next test.

1. All PASS labels and test records to be scanned and attached to the appropriate submittal tab in the portal.
